title: Kicked Peppery Kenyan Tomato Skewers
description: A vegetarian-friendly Kenyan dish featuring double-fried tomatoes, served in an agave leaf vessel, with a peppery kick and a shattering crunch. This adventurous recipe is perfect for those looking to try something new and exciting.

ingredients.name: tomatoes
ingredients.notes: any variety, but firmer tomatoes work best

instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Wash and dry the tomatoes, then cut them into 1-inch pieces.
Double-fry the tomato pieces by first frying them for 2 minutes at 325 degrees Fahrenheit, then increasing the heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and frying for an additional 2 minutes.
In a bowl, mix together the black pepper, cayenne pepper, and salt.
Add the fried tomato pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the pepper mixture.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the tomato pieces and sprinkle with garlic powder if using.
Prepare the agave leaves by washing and drying them, then cutting out the thick stem at the base of each leaf.
To assemble the skewers, place 2-3 tomato pieces onto each agave leaf, leaving a small border around the edges.
Serve the Kicked Peppery Kenyan Tomato Skewers immediately, garnished with additional black pepper if desired.
